_comment: Scripted demo runs. `need` is what any buyer agent would declare from `text`. `scenario` turns on a labeled demo overlay for the whole run; `scenario_after_find` switches it on between find_offers and place_order (e.g. a price rise). `naive_first_quantity` makes the agent's first attempt sloppy to show self-correction.

presets.title: 1. Partial stock + substitute + over limit -> approval
presets.text: I need 1,000 litres of lactose-free milk by Monday. Find an option that meets our requirements based on price and availability.

need.text: I need 1,000 litres of lactose-free milk by Monday. Find an option that meets our requirements based on price and availability.

presets.title: 2. Routine weekly order -> placed automatically
presets.text: Our usual weekly 60 litres of lactose-free milk for Monday, please.

need.text: Our usual weekly 60 litres of lactose-free milk for Monday, please.

presets.title: 3. Allergen-strict school, missing allergen data -> escalation
presets.text: 40 kg of potatoes for Monday. Remember we are a nut-free school kitchen.

need.text: 40 kg of potatoes for Monday. Remember we are a nut-free school kitchen.

presets.title: 4. Wrong lot size -> precise error -> agent fixes it
presets.text: 100 kg of sea bass for Monday, cheapest option.

need.text: 100 kg of sea bass for Monday, cheapest option.

presets.title: 5. Price rises between offer and order -> approval
presets.text: Order 80 litres of lactose-free milk for Monday.

need.text: Order 80 litres of lactose-free milk for Monday.
